title: I don’t know who needs to hear this, but never EVER disclose that you used AI for your game
author: Icy_Masterpiece_4414
selftext:
In 2007, BlackBerry harshly refused to adopt the concept of smartphones that Apple introduced. This refusal for technological improvement left them in the dust and they lost everything.

Nowadays, a huge part of the world is like BlackBerry. People just don’t understand how useful and how much of the future AI for your personal projects is.

People are so anti AI that you genuinely question if they ever questioned how it’s actually used in game development. If you claim your game is made with AI assistance be assured that you’re not going to sell it.  
Did you hear the recent Big Walk game disaster?  
This insanely popular and liked game had a bug that slowed its running down to 50% during sunset and sunrises.  
The studio asked the engineers how to fix this, the engineers said there is nothing that can be done.  
They asked a chatbot and in a minute it found a 10 lines of code that needed to be changed and now the bug was fixed. Not even 0,1% of the game. That was the only time AI was used.  
They disclosed this to the public and in one day the reviews dropped and people asked for refunds.

Guys, trust me on this, the general population doesn’t care.  
It doesn’t care if you did the planning, the idea, the hours spent improving and polishing, the money you spent out of your own wage, they only care if you used AI.  
For them it doesn’t matter if you never managed to learn coding and can’t afford a developer that will give you in 8 months a mediocre result.  
It doesn’t matter if everything else is man made.  
It doesn’t matter if only 0,1% of the game is AI made, they only care about complaining about the water usage (all while staying on social medias for hours on end which spends far more water than a normal use of a chatbot).

So, if you want my suggestion: nobody is pointing a gun to your head to tell the truth behind the development process of your game. Big companies literally encrypt and try to hide as much info as possible to the general public.   
I’m not saying lie, I’m saying just don’t disclose it.  
These people, just like blackberry, don’t understand. Times need to pass for them to adapt to the change.

Never  
Ever  
Disclose  
AI  
Assistance

A mod will review this removal and can restore the post if it was a mistake. You don't need to do anything, but you can [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev) if you want to add context.
